posts.preview: Many women in the workplace experience discrimination, sometimes unknowingly. We must continue advocating for equal pay for equal work and for workplaces that recognise women’s needs
Trade Unions must integrate these needs into collective bargaining, including menstrual and menopause flexible time, breastfeeding flexibility, workplace daycare facilities, and free sanitary pads
Women’s needs must remain part of the collective bargaining agenda for a fair, dignified and supportive workplace See less
Add volume to that HON, women and disability people have become a victim for that at work place .
